name: Image Publication and Duplicate Review
description: Imports an image the subject owns, then routes duplicate and publication review to the Images workbench.

inputs.name: evidence_id
inputs.label: Supplied by the 'Run with file' action

legal_notes: Images the subject owns or has authorised. No facial recognition or identification of people is performed.
quota_note: No network requests (works on local data)
example_output: A de-duplicated dataset saved as evidence, with every finding linked to its source response.
capability_gaps: Reverse-image search cannot be automated: providers offer interactive or commercial access only. The review step is manual.
instructions: Imports an image the subject owns, then routes duplicate and publication review to the Images workbench.

definition.name: Image Publication and Duplicate Review
definition.description: Imports an image the subject owns, then routes duplicate and publication review to the Images workbench.

config.prompt: Open Target profile > Images. Review local duplicate matches, then use the manual provider links (Google Lens, Bing Visual Search, TinEye). A provider result is a page candidate, not an identification of anyone.
